final_message:
I've built the 9-slide October 2025 monthly report (Month 2 of 6). I couldn't open it in PowerPoint here, so the layout hasn't been checked visually. The spend totals match the values saved in the spreadsheet, and I've re-read the slides against each other and fixed the contradictions I found.

**Headline status at 30 October 2025**
- **Schedule (Green):** WP1 is on plan and the log says Output 1 will be delivered by 7 November. WP2 to WP4 haven't started and keep their planned dates (WP2 from the week of 3 November; the project ends in February 2026).
- **Spend (Amber):** £10,298.70 has been spent against a budget profile of £9,874.37 to date, so £424.33 (4.3%) over. September was £1,044.17 over and October was £619.83 under the monthly profile. £19,324.40 of the £29,623.10 budget remains.
- **Cause of the overspend:** the Information Manager has used 20 of 36 budgeted days, mostly in September when requirements were re-checked at Common Ground Bikes.
- **Risk (Green):** no risk is rated High after mitigation. The SpinBits database concern was resolved on 6 October.

**Problems in the inputs, noted on the slides themselves**
- **Spreadsheet date:** the spend spreadsheet is dated 3 November, after the report date. I used the figures as recorded and noted they'll be confirmed at the November spend review.
- **Broken sheet:** the "4.0 Current project costs" sheet has its role rows linked one row out of line and gives a wrong total (£9,733.10). I worked the figures out from the weekly burn profile instead and noted the sheet needs fixing.
- **Overhead label:** the label says £6,826.50 total overhead, but the calculated figure is £6,836.10. I used £6,836.10.
- **Risk numbering:** the project log calls the SpinBits problem "risk 4", but in the risk register it matches risk 1. I've proposed updating the register, which has no status, owner or date columns.
- **Output 1 timing:** the log has Output 1 going to Professor Dodge on 7 November, but stakeholder comments run until 9 November. This is raised as a question for the assessor on the Current Focus and Q&A slides.

The workspace and attachments folders were empty, so there was no registry or draft to check; everything comes from the four input files. The Green/Amber ratings and the questions on the Q&A slide are my own judgement as Project Manager. Sources are listed in the speaker notes.

DONE
